# Synthetic C2 fixtures

These files describe schema/rendering states only. They contain no actual
organizations, vendor observations, measured forecasts, or evaluation results.
Artifact hashes and paths are placeholders. Do not use them as a real demo.

The reference/target dates are PLAN.md section 3.3's worked boundary example.
`immature-outcome.json` is a nullable LabelRow, not a reveal response;
`mature-outcome.json` is the separately validated reveal contract. Forecast
fixtures contain no actual outcome fields. The unvalidated-interval fixture
deliberately omits a serving band. The evaluation example reports no metrics.
